title: Inflorescence and Floral Meristems: Identity, Position and Determinacy
word_count_method: Count words only in saved p.teaching-prose; exclude headings, tables, SVGs, questions, answers, captions, revision, references and UI. Count whitespace tokens containing letters or numerals.

validation.comparator: 5.C.05: 14,222 marked teaching words; same green reader and substantive narrative approach.
validation.quantitative_checks: 8h plastochron:12 initiations/4d; 6h for 3d at 75%=9 flowers; 3/12 to 9/12=50 percentage points; binary generation 4=16 tips and 31 cumulative; binding fractions 3/5 and 1/3.

dimensions.M: 6,14; crop and research context, clinical use not applicable

review_pass_1: Internal scientific and syllabus audit: verified official CSIR syllabi, mirrored MP SET and roadmap; reviewed LFY/AP1/CAL, TFL1/FT/FD, WUS/CLV and AG, meristem size and termination, comparative species. Added primary evidence for WUS/CLV, TFL1 mobility and auxin positioning. Recomputed quantitative examples and marked hypothetical data.
review_pass_2: Separate internal teaching and examination audit: reviewed narrative progression, figures, traps, recall and practice; clarified observed vs classified primordia; checked answer positions and option text, IDs, anchors, zoom targets, script syntax and comparator.

quality.type: internal editorial assessment, not external peer review
quality.deductions: Selective full-paper access; recurring conceptual framing; hypothetical quantitative models; uncalibrated questions with some straightforward distractors; no independent interactive browser/device test (−1 each).

limitations: MP SET 2024 verified from third-party mirror rather than MPPSC primary host.
Selective full-paper access; internal review only, not external peer review.
Interactive browser and assistive-technology testing not independently performed.
